name: pre-push
title: Pre-Push Security Gate
description: Deterministic data leak detection for OSS repos. Scans files against configurable wordlist (YAML) to catch internal IDs, credentials, and personal data before pushing.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: target_path
inputs.description: File path or directory to scan

inputs.name: wordlist_path
inputs.description: Path to wordlist configuration file (YAML format)

inputs.name: fail_on_match
inputs.description: Exit with failure status if any error-severity matches found

gates.prompt:
Evaluate pre-push security scan results.

Wordlist config:
{{wordlist_content}}

Scan results:
{{scan_results}}

Your task:
1. Parse wordlist categories and their severity (error|warning)
2. Match scan results against each pattern
3. Count matches by severity
4. Decision: if any 'error' severity match → FAIL, else → PASS

Return JSON: { "status":"PASS|FAIL", "error_count":0, "warning_count":0, "categories_hit":[], "matches":[{"file":"","line":0,"pattern":"","severity":""}] }

Generate a pre-push security report.

Evaluation: {{evaluator}}

If status is FAIL: produce a concise markdown report with summary (counts by severity), findings grouped by category, and remediation steps.
If status is PASS: output a single line: 'PASS: No sensitive data detected.'
